cim: Concordia plans new artificial intelligence major
cim_eredeti: Concordia plans new artificial intelligence major
szoveg_eredeti:
MOORHEAD — Concordia is launching a new major in artificial intelligence.

But they want every student in every major to get comfortable with the technology.

Concordia College in Moorhead recently received a $3 million grant from the Department of Education.

The grant money will be dispersed over five years and is focused on preparing students for the modern workforce.

With that, the college will be working on a new major in artificial intelligence for students who want to specialize in the field, but they also want students across every major to work with AI.

"We're looking to develop a workforce readiness competency framework that will help us think about both AI skills but also deepening and aligning our commitment to the liberal arts skills as well," said Dr. Susan Larson, provost and dean of Concordia College.

The college is hoping the new major will be off the ground as soon as fall 2027.
